analysis.actions: Maintain and update the Information Collections Under Review page with new information collection entries and last update dates.
analysis.affected_scope: Information collections under review (FR 28, FR O) and the Information Collections Under Review page
analysis.impact: Stakeholders will see updated information collection statuses and new reporting forms (FR 28, FR O) on the page. The last update date reflects the most recent information collection update.
analysis.reason: The changes include the addition of new information collection updates (FR 28 OMB supporting statement, FR O draft instructions) and a revision of the last update date to October 26, 2026, which are substantive changes to the information collection page.
analysis.summary: The Information Collections Under Review page was updated with new information collection entries (FR 28 and FR O) and the last update date was changed from October 08, 2026 to October 26, 2026.
